name: imports
cmd: set -e; date -Is; echo processes; ps -eo pid,ppid,etime,pcpu,comm,args --sort=-pcpu | head -n 18; echo install; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; echo installed; timeout 12s bun -e 'console.error("start"); await import("./core/machine.ts"); console.error("machine"); await import("./kernel/kernel.ts"); console.error("kernel"); await import("./kernel/prove.ts"); console.error("prove"); await import("./research/track-m/lift-count-proxies.ts"); console.error("lift"); await import("./research/track-m/boolean-core.ts"); console.error("boolean"); await import("./research/track-m/field-bound-lemmas.ts"); console.error("field");'; echo done
